from typing import List, Optional
from pydantic import BaseModel

class SearchResultsOutputModel(BaseModel):
    search_results: List[Dict] = Field(
        default=None, description="List of search results."
    )
    query_summary: Optional[str] = Field(
        default=None, description="Response to customer."
    )
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")

# Retrieve cached hotel search results
prior_results = get_results_from_cache(key="hotels")

# Apply filters based on user's request
filtered_hotels = filter_hotels(
    prior_results=prior_results,
    checkin_date=["2025-05-15", "2025-05-16", "2025-05-17", "2025-05-18", "2025-05-19", "2025-05-20", "2025-05-21", "2025-05-22"],
    checkout_date=["2025-05-15", "2025-05-16", "2025-05-17", "2025-05-18", "2025-05-19", "2025-05-20", "2025-05-21", "2025-05-22"],
    num_rooms=2,
    budget=1100,
    stars=[3, 4, 5],
    gym_present=True,
    pool_present=True,
    breakfast_included=True,
    air_conditioning_present=True,
    heating_present=True,
    free_wifi_included=True,
    is_wheelchair_accessible=True
)

# Save the filtered results to cache
save_to_cache(key="filtered_hotels", value=filtered_hotels)

# Sort results by price per night
sorted_hotels = sort_results(
    results=filtered_hotels,
    column="price_per_night",
    ascending=True
)

# Save sorted results to cache
save_to_cache(key="sorted_hotels", value=sorted_hotels)

# Output summary
print("No planning needed")
